gen.title: Finding your total monthly payment and what affects it

cards.stem: What does the mortgage company do with money held in your escrow account?
options: holds the money in the escrow account
invests it in the stock market
applies it directly to reduce principal
returns it as cash each month
cards.quote: Your mortgage company typically holds the money in the escrow account until those insurance and tax bills are due, and then pays them on your behalf
cards.hint: Think about when taxes and insurance are paid.

cards.stem: Which part of your mortgage payment generally stays the same if you pay on time?
cards.quote: your principal and interest payment will generally remain the same as long as you make regular payments on time
cards.hint: This part covers what you borrowed and the charge for borrowing.

cards.stem: What kinds of additional costs can be included in your total monthly payment beyond principal and interest?
cards.quote: your total monthly payment usually includes additional costs like homeowners insurance, taxes, and possibly mortgage insurance
cards.hint: Think about costs for protecting the home and local taxes.
